title: I would like to test out this Space game we developed.
author: Onelovetwo
selftext: We created an in-browser game called Solaris Pace. It takes place in the year 5858. We had a war with AI, and many humans live across the solar system. Your mission is to get cargo from one planet to another and avoid the AI bots. ( The AI bots are real- they learn your moves and change each level based on you) I hope you like. [https://solarispace.ai/](https://solarispace.ai/)

comments.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
comments.body:
This is not ready for public playtesting. The controls don't work properly, the ship seemingly only fires backwards. Navigation is nearly impossible and confusing. 

I don't mean to be harsh, it's cool that you're making a game but you have a long way to go before it's ready to be shared.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: What do you recommend? I love the feedback

replies.author: ArchivisX
replies.body: You should be playtesting your own game and looking for your own bugs and putting it out for others to test when you can no longer find issues of your own.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: I do it was way worse than this. But I am at the point where I am unsure what else is wrong. You are right, I can not find errors. This feedback is great. I love your Fire backward, for I always shoot when hovering. So, as you can see, this is like water to me. You are the best for even typing

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: I just told you what I recommend, fix the controls, actually playtest your game.  It's beyond me why you would purchase a domain with the game in this state.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: Thanks. I guess I was a little confused about the controls. I am new to this. Are you saying not to use up, down, left, and right for flying? Or are you saying the Q&E was not helpful? Or both. You are not harsh at all. We get a lot of traffic, but I want it to be better, so I'm using this to get feedback.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: I see the issues with the fire- when in flight, the ship moves faster than the laser, it only works when standing still. Will work on that. And you are not harsh, I love it.

replies.author: Aromatic-Low-4578
replies.body: The problem isn't that the controls don't work, it's that they don't feel good to use.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: Ok. I will see what we can do. I was following the format of others who do not use a mouse. Do you use a mouse when you play a PC game? When you do play a PC game, do you move around the environment? Thanks in advance. We made some changes, and the users stay on longer. So we appreciate you so much

replies.author: rarewalkerant
replies.body: Ok, if you want space dog fights, fire up freelancer/Freespace (or any space sim) and just see what they FEEL like. What controls what and  how you want your ship to behave. Get that dialed in first. Then build up on that.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: Thank you. I have checked it out and made some changes, so I appreciate your reply.

comments.author: rarewalkerant
comments.body: This is a basic engine prototype (also nothing like the screenshot above). Controls are awful, they don't work for dogfighting at all. UI needs a ton of work (barely exists, no cohesion). This needs a ton of polish and many many iterations before public testing.

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: What do you recommend? I love the feedback

replies.author: Onelovetwo
replies.body: Thank you so much for the post. What would be something you would change. I am new to all this and the visitors to the page is getting larger so would love feedback. Working on the others below. Any suggestions don't worry about being harsh .
